statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : ℕ → Set (W 0)) (a : ℝ), (∀ i, ¬ i < N → U i = ∅) → (∑' i, ⨆ (_ : (U i).Nonempty), Metric.ediam (U i) ^ a) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ⨆ (_ : (U i).Nonempty), Metric.ediam (U i) ^ a
proof:
intro N U a h
apply tsum_eq_sum
intro i hi
have hi' : ¬ i < N := by simpa only [Finset.mem_range] using hi
simp [h i hi']
